class.name: GraphicsPresetSettings
class.brief_description: Settings resource of [GraphicsPresetSettingsServer]: the name of the chosen graphics preset.
class.description: The data of the settings domain [code]"graphics_preset"[/code]. [GraphicsPresetSettingsServer] keeps three copies of it (defaults, applied and pending values, see [method SettingsServer.get_settings]) and stores it in [code]user://settings/graphics_preset.ini[/code]. The values of the preset itself are stored by the video domains ([RenderQualitySettingsServer], [TextureSettingsServer], [ShadowSettingsServer], [RenderEffectSettingsServer]), so a [code]"Custom"[/code] state keeps its values without duplicates. Change the preset with [method GraphicsPresetSettingsServer.apply_preset], not on the resource.

members.member: The name of the preset the player picked, [code]"Custom"[/code] after a change of a single value, or empty if no preset was picked yet (then [method GraphicsPresetSettingsServer.get_current_preset] detects it from the values).
